-- djb2 over the bytes of T.NameKey(title), mod 2^32, as 8 lowercase hex chars.
-- Mirrors tools/wfa/core.py title_hash: the data stores this hash instead of
-- the English quest title. h * 33 + byte stays below 2^38 (exact in doubles);
-- the hex is built by hand because %x on a 32-bit client int would overflow.
local HEX = "0123456789abcdef"
function F.TitleHash(title)
    if type(title) ~= "string" or title == "" or not F.T or not F.T.NameKey then
        return ""
    end
    local s = F.T.NameKey(title)
    if s == "" then
        return ""
    end
    local h = 5381
    for i = 1, #s do
        h = (h * 33 + string.byte(s, i)) % 4294967296
    end
    local out = ""
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        local d = h % 16
        out = string.sub(HEX, d + 1, d + 1) .. out
        h = (h - d) / 16
    end
    return out
end

local function name_fa(fam, en)
    local names = F.D.names or {}
    local tbl
    if fam == "npc" then
        tbl = names.npc
    elseif fam == "it" then
        tbl = names.itn
    elseif fam == "ob" then
        tbl = names.obj
    else
        return nil
    end
    -- wowfa2: v1.0 ships no npc / item / object name tables (locked kinds), so
    -- the English name rides in the marker: the line still gets the Persian
    -- verb and the live counts, exactly what the v0 lock showed in game
    return (tbl and tbl[T.NameKey(en)]) or en
end

-- WoWFA v1 runtime tests: the built addon (out/dist/WoWFA) on the WoW mock, under
-- lua5.1 (WoW's Lua). Run by tools/ci.py from the repo root: lua5.1 tests/run.lua <dist>
-- Every check names WHAT broke; any failure exits 1 and turns CI red.
local ROOT = arg[1] or "out/dist/WoWFA"
WOWFA_TEST_UNLOCK = false -- test the REAL release lock, never the mock's dev unlock
dofile("tests/lua/wow_mock.lua")

local passes, fails = 0, 0
local function check(name, cond, detail)
    if cond then
        passes = passes + 1
        print("ok   " .. name)
    else
        fails = fails + 1
        print("FAIL " .. name .. (detail ~= nil and (": " .. tostring(detail)) or ""))
    end
end
local function non_ascii(s)
    return type(s) == "string" and s:find("[\128-\255]") ~= nil
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- load the TOC
local toc = ROOT .. "/WoWFA_Forever.toc"
local fh = io.open(toc, "r")
check("toc exists", fh ~= nil, toc)
if not fh then
    os.exit(1)
end
local nfiles = 0
for line in fh:lines() do
    line = line:gsub("\r$", "")
    if line ~= "" and not line:find("^##") then
        local p = ROOT .. "/" .. line:gsub("\\", "/")
        local f, err = loadfile(p)
        check("load " .. line, f ~= nil, err)
        if f then
            local ok, e = pcall(f, "WoWFA", {})
            check("run " .. line, ok, e)
            nfiles = nfiles + 1
        end
    end
end
fh:close()
local F = WoWFAF
check("addon table", type(F) == "table")
if type(F) ~= "table" then
    os.exit(1)
end
